q.g: In this quest you have to hand over 2 6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armors. One with 0-75% durability and one with 75-100% durability. The armors require no inserted armor plates since the condition is measured by the integrated soft armor. Since friendly fire is always active, you can easily complete this quest with the help of a another player through the use of a Blicky pistol. Another way to complete this quest solo is to let border snipers shoot you so that your character dies far outside the playable space of the map. You can insure the armor with Prapor to receive it back in roughly a day to a day and a half, but it will be quicker if you use Therapist to insure it. You may have to do this method multiple times for the same armor to get it down to the required durability.
